## HostBindings type

Attributes, properties, and events to bind on a template's host element. Keys use the same aspect prefixes as HTML template bindings.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type HostBindings<TSource = any, TParent = any> = Record<string, Expression<TSource, any, TParent> | Binding<TSource, any, TParent> | string | number | boolean | null | undefined>;
```
